description: Bulk-endpoint for portfolio-screening of 'foretak i vanskeligheter' (financially distressed companies per EU GBER art. 2(18) criteria a-e, assessed at both company and group level). Max 50 orgnr per call. Each orgnr counts as one unit against your quota. Gate failures (invalid orgnr, missing entitlement) are returned per orgnr in the result list instead of failing the whole call — check each result's `error` field. Note: the distress assessment has no organisation-form gate — a sole proprietorship (ENK) is assessed like any other company. Use for screening supplier lists, credit-portfolios, or EU state-aid eligibility on multiple companies at once.

orgnrs.description: List of 1-50 nine-digit Norwegian organization numbers. Each orgnr counts as one unit against your quota.
orgnrs.title: Orgnrs

skip_freshness.description: If True, accept FIV-data even if the underlying regnskap- or BRREG-snapshot is older than the normal freshness window. Use sparingly — recommended only for retrospective screening.
skip_freshness.title: Skip Freshness

name: firmaradar_check_fiv_bulk

BulkFivResult.description: Per-organization result in a bulk FIV response.

classifier_version.description: Immutable version stamp for the FIV rule set used.
classifier_version.title: Classifier Version

classifier_version_sequence.description: Authoritative monotonic ordering key for classifier_version; compare this field, not the version string, to order rule sets.
classifier_version_sequence.title: Classifier Version Sequence

distress_basis.description: Which level of the two-level assessment makes the company distressed: company, group or company_and_group. 'group' means the company's own accounts are clean but its group is in difficulty — sufficient under GBER art. 2(18).
distress_basis.title: Distress Basis

error.description: Error type when the assessment could not be completed. Validation: `invalid_orgnr`. Rollout/configuration (shared extension dispatcher): `extension_not_active`, `extension_controls_unavailable`, `data_provider_failed`, `handler_not_found`, `handler_http_exception`, `handler_failed`, `unexpected_handler_return`. The bulk runner itself: `internal_error` (outside the dispatcher). On a runtime-control failure (rate limit, compliance gate) `error` is NOT one of the codes above — the field then keeps the control layer's human-readable text, and the machine code lives in `error_code`. The same text is mirrored in `message`. The distress assessment has NO organization-form gate — there is no ENK error code here.
error.title: Error

error_code.description: Stable machine code for runtime-control failures, set additively by the dispatcher when a control BEFORE the handler rejects the call. Rate limit: `rate_limit_exceeded`. Compliance gate: `compliance_gate_revoked`, `compliance_gate_expired`, `compliance_gate_manifest_unavailable`, `compliance_gate_unavailable`. Which gate reasons can occur follows the extension manifest, and the distress module requires no external authorization — that gate reason does not exist here. The distress handler does not set the field itself, and neither do the dispatcher and runner errors (including the 503 response when the extension controls cannot be read): they live in `error` only. An absent `error_code` means "not a runtime-control failure", not "no error". Always read `error` as well.
error_code.title: Error Code

http_status.description: HTTP status this per-company result would have had outside the outer HTTP-200 bulk response.
http_status.title: Http Status

message.description: Human-readable detail from the runtime-control layer.
message.title: Message

rescuable_by_group.description: True when the company triggers only the capital criterion and its group is sound enough to remedy it before the aid is granted.
rescuable_by_group.title: Rescuable By Group

retry_after.description: Retry-After header value when the row was rate limited.
retry_after.title: Retry After

status.description: FIV (foretak i vanskeligheter / company-in-difficulty) status when available: not_distressed, distressed, insufficient_data, exempt_young_company, not_distressed_partial. Absent when error is set.
status.title: Status

verdict_presentation.description: Qualified display verdict. Label and caveat footnote are one object; missing or incomplete legacy blocks yield null, never a guessed clean verdict.

BulkFivResult.title: BulkFivResult

footnote.description: Mandatory qualification when qualification_status is present, including open-data, group-level and rescuable verdicts.
footnote.title: Footnote

has_caveat.description: Whether the label carries the open-data (*) marker. This is distinct from whether another material qualification is required.
has_caveat.title: Has Caveat

qualification_status.description: Whether this verdict requires no qualification or carries the required qualification. A missing required qualification rejects the entire presentation instead of producing this object.
qualification_status.title: Qualification Status

_meta.description: Aggregate count status for the whole bulk call.

summary.description: Human-readable markdown table of the per-company FIV verdicts.
summary.title: Summary
